mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, COLLECTION_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, COLLECTION_ID DESC

SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(CL.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LIKED_DT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CLC.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COLLECTION_LIKE MY_CL WHERE MY_CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID AND MY_CL.MEMBER_ID = #{currentMemberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
0 AS LIKED_BY_CURRENT_MEMBER, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL1, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL2, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL3, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL4, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL5 FROM COLLECTION_LIKE CL JOIN COLLECTION C ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CLC ON CLC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 1 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL1, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 2 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL2, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 3 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL3, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 4 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL4, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 5 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL5 FROM ( SELECT CI.COLLECTION_ID, CONTENT.POSTER_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CI.COLLECTION_ID ORDER BY CI.ADDED_DT DESC, CI.CONTENT_ID DESC ) AS POSTER_ORDER FROM COLLECTION_ITEM CI JOIN CONTENT ON CONTENT.CONTENT_ID = CI.CONTENT_ID WHERE CONTENT.POSTER_URL IS NOT NULL ) WHERE POSTER_ORDER <= 5 GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CP ON CP.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID WHERE CL.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND ( C.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' OR C.MEMBER_ID = #{currentMemberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) ORDER BY CL.CREATED_DT DESC, C.COLLECTION_ID DESC OFFSET (#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT MEMBER_ID, COLLECTION_ID, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId} ORDER BY CREATED_DT DESC, MEMBER_ID DESC
